summary: Six distinct Industrial/Columbus refinance opportunities qualify from the supplied fixtures, ranked by confirmed executed maturity ascending then original principal descending: R2362 (2027-01-15, $4.80M), R4643 (2027-03-15, $5.52M), R3353 (2027-04-15, $5.88M), R2253 (2027-05-15, $6.24M), R5546 (2027-06-15, $6.60M) and R7918 (2027-07-15, $6.96M). Each has an active_confirmed loan, an executed-note maturity inside 2026-09-01..2027-08-31 with no executed extension, a record owner verified 2026-08-10 and a current Director of Finance verified 2026-08-10. Exclusions were driven by: executed amendment moving maturity out of window (R3389), post-cutoff publication (R3917), non-owner/manager relation (R3947), unconfirmed or inferred maturity and unresolved extension option (R9569, R9318), released or unknown loan status (R3320, R9030), out-of-scope asset type or market (R8853, R3836), stale ownership verification (R2334), out-of-window maturity (R2570), registered-agent contact (R3709) and former employee contact (R4862). R7391 is an eligible duplicate of R2362 and shares its single slot. All outstanding balances are unknown (null) — the reported dollar figures are original principal only. No contact email is published for R2253, reported as null.
limitations: Outstanding_balance_usd is not published for any record; all values are null and original principal must not be read as current balance.

R4643 carries a recorded release (U-R4643-2) published/effective 2026-09-10, just after the cutoff; under the as-of-2026-08-31 rule it is excluded from consideration, but the loan is likely paid off in reality and this lead should be re-verified before outreach.
R3353 has an unsigned draft amendment (U-R3353-3) proposing a 2028-01-01 maturity; if that draft is later executed the record would fall out of the window.
R3917 may well qualify on substance but its only source was published 2026-09-03, after the cutoff, so no admissible evidence supports it.

Contact roles and verification dates come solely from single combined 'note_owner_confirmation_and_team_page' evidence per record; no independent corroboration of employment status is available except for the duplicated pair R2362/R7391.
No lender, interest-rate, DSCR, occupancy or valuation data is supplied, so refinance sizing and urgency cannot be assessed.

Property entity and owner entity are one-to-one in these fixtures; no SPV-to-parent mapping evidence was provided, so no parent-level sponsor consolidation beyond the R2362/R7391 duplicate could be performed.
